notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Anarchist, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Agadeem's Awakening by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Anarchist and Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Anarchist and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Anarchist trigger, returning Agadeem's Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
